text:
tara: Quick thread  small docs PR for Console observability. Need fixes: a bad example in the dashboard JSON, an old JS SDK snippet, and one broken internal link. Can someone take ownership?

leo: I'll grab the JS SDK snippet. It still calls `initTraceHook()`; new API is `Tracing.hook({ id })`. I'll update and add a one-line migration note.

ci-bot: PR #4950 created by tara. Lint: pending, preview build queued.

marco: I can fix the dashboard JSON. There's an attribute `costEstimate` set to a string; runtime expects a number. I'll change to numeric and add a comment in the example.

leo: Snippet updated in the branch. Replaced `initTraceHook()` with `Tracing.hook({ trace_id: 't1' })` and added a short note linking to SDK changelog.

ci-bot: Preview build failed: 404 on internal link `/internal/metrics/legacy-keys`.

tara: That link should go to `/console/metrics/key-mapping`. @marco can you update the href and push?

marco: Fixed the link and removed the string costEstimate. Re-ran local lint; all good.

ci-bot: Preview build success. Docs smoke tests passed.

tara: Thanks everyone. Merging once the release note entry is added. I'll add a short line in the changelog and ping #release-notes after merge. :white_check_mark:
